headline: Sensex and Nifty trade volatile near 23,000 as India VIX slumps; Motilal Oswal and IDBI Bank in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: India VIX slumped over 7%, suggesting a decrease in market fear and volatility expectations
Rising oil prices and global bond yields are creating headwinds for Indian equities
The IT sector is experiencing a pullback, dragging down broader index gains
Strategic stake sale evaluations for IDBI Bank are driving interest in the banking sector
whatHappening: Nifty 50 is struggling to maintain levels above 23,100 amid volatile trading sessions
Motilal Oswal group secured a SEBI custodian license to begin operations from the fourth quarter
Suzuki announced plans to halve vehicle development time and expand its production capacity in India by 2030
The government is evaluating financial bids for a strategic stake sale in IDBI Bank
summary: The Indian market is trading range-bound with Nifty hovering near 23,000 while the India VIX has dropped significantly. Key developments include Motilal Oswal receiving a SEBI custodian license and the government evaluating bids for IDBI Bank. Sectoral performance is mixed as IT faces pressure while realty shows gains.
